title: Final Equations of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equations of motion for the system.

title: Conservation of Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and express the conservation of linear momentum for the center of mass.

title: Kinetic Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the total kinetic energy of the system.

title: Potential Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the potential energy due to the springs.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion.
